intro: Monday on Stocktwits was a full emotional arc: KC called in sick to Wendy's to ride the wave, got pulled back in for an afternoon shift when the market dropped, and closed the day with a two-word eulogy. Hustle never sleeps. 🌊🍔

items.caption: Morning confidence level: maximum. KC is skipping the fryer to surf $SPY and $TSLA. That's commitment to the craft. 🏄
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA calling in sick to Wendy’s so I can ride this wave 🌊

items.caption: Plot twist: the wave went the other way, and our guy clocked back in for the afternoon. A true professional always has a backup plan. 💼
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA Market dropped and I had to go in and pick up an afternoon shift!!!

items.caption: The shortest, most heartfelt market recap of the day. Fitting for All Souls Day. 🕯️
